title: imp/{site}/conflict/{key} payload
description: UPSERT payload of imp/{site}/conflict/{key}: a re-import found {key} changed both in the app and at the source since the last import, and wrote neither (import.proto). The source's side is the base, imp/{site}/base/{key}. Pending while this is live and {key}'s version is still `against`, or, with no `against`, while {key} has no version. Serialized, at most 112 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it. Server-owned: a Push of this key is REJECTED facet_key_not_user_owned.

against.description: {key}'s version when the conflict was raised, in the full user-facet form <instant>#<counter>#<device>. Absent when {key} had no version (a copy the import raised for addition).

export_date.description: The export_date of the import that raised or last updated it, "YYYY-MM-DD".
